title: VirnyFlow: Optimizing ML Pipelines for Accuracy, Fairness, and Stability at Scale
abstract: arXiv:2506.01584v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Developing machine learning (ML) systems for real-world deployment requires navigating context-dependent trade-offs among accuracy, fairness, stability, and other objectives. Existing AutoML frameworks optimize pipelines efficiently, but they fix the optimization objective up front, leave it outside the developer's control during search, and rarely scale beyond a single node. We present VirnyFlow, a system that optimizes ML pipelines jointly for accuracy, fairness, and stability at scale. A user-defined evaluation protocol, with fairness measured over binary and intersectional groups, drives every layer of the optimizer: multi-objective Bayesian optimization of physical pipelines, cost-aware bandit selection of logical pipelines, and multi-criterion pruning. translated_title: VirnyFlow：在大规模上优化机器学习流水线的准确性、公平性与稳定性
translated_abstract: 摘要：开发用于实际部署的机器学习（ML）系统需要应对准确性、公平性、稳定性及其他目标之间依赖于上下文情境的权衡。现有的AutoML框架能够高效优化流水线，但它们在搜索前固定优化目标，使其在搜索过程中不受开发者控制，并且很少能扩展到单节点之外。我们提出了VirnyFlow，一个在大规模上联合优化机器学习流水线的准确性、公平性和稳定性的系统。用户定义的评估协议（其中公平性在二元和交叉群体上测量）驱动优化器的每一层：物理流水线的多目标贝叶斯优化、逻辑流水线的成本感知臂选择，以及多准则剪枝。该架构结合了基于Apache Kafka的异步执行和数据库支持的实验管理，提供了细粒度并行性、容错性和集成能力。
tldr: VirnyFlow通过用户定义的评估协议驱动多目标贝叶斯优化、成本感知臂选择和多准则剪枝，实现了在大规模上联合优化机器学习流水线的准确性、公平性和稳定性。
en_tdlr: VirnyFlow jointly optimizes ML pipelines for accuracy, fairness, and stability at scale by driving multi-objective Bayesian optimization, cost-aware bandit selection, and multi-criterion pruning through a user-defined evaluation protocol.
